items.title: Frank Naundorf Interview, 1965-02-25
items.q: That is Dr. Abi Hübner from Hamburg, who wrote that.

ctx.x: Yes, this letter I have just from one, that is the main speaker of the King Oliver direction in Germany. That is Dr. Abi Hübner from Hamburg, who wrote that. That is a very good trumpet. And his cell, they play in the Oliver direction. And there are also in Frankfurt, Oliver Benz, and this kind of, and also in Berlin. And they all belong to a company, which is called the Society for the New Orleans Jazz. And Mr. Hübner wrote, that he could not understand it, and that not only a birth certificate from New Orleans…
And what did you say about the Tuxedo Band? Oh, yes.
